t: You're looking at the Hyde Park Corner Screen, a structure in the City of Westminster. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects and landscapers of the nineteenth century. Burton was the leading Victorian architect in the Roman Revival, Greek Revival and Georgian neoclassical styles, and a founding fellow and vice-president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He also designed the clubhouse of the Athenaeum Club, which his father's company built.
